item.title: Amish Fall Farmhouse Experience at Old Windmill Farm — Fri Oct 9 — Old Windmill Farm
item.description:
An autumn afternoon in our farm kitchen. Join us as we bake bread, churn butter from our own cows’ cream, and press apple cider with a traditional hand-cranked apple press. Then sit down and enjoy all three together, with the freshly churned butter on the bread warm from the oven.
Press fresh cider with a traditional press Churn butter from our own cows’ cream Enjoy freshly baked bread Drink cider and eat bread with fresh butter A working farm kitchen, not a demonstration Advance reservations required
Part of the visit is outdoors – dress for the weather. Book This Tour

item.title: Harvest Days at Landis Valley Museum — Sat Oct 10 — Landis Valley Village & Farm Museum
item.description:
Harvest Days returns to Landis Valley Village & Farm Museum on October 10–11, 2026, inviting families, history enthusiasts, and fall lovers to celebrate one of Lancaster County’s original autumn traditions. Explore the sights, sounds, and traditions of Pennsylvania German culture through hands-on activities, historic demonstrations, traditional crafts, live music, and seasonal foods. Across the museum’s historic grounds, visitors can discover the agricultural practices, foodways, and craftsmanship that connect today’s visitors to rural life in the 1800s and early 1900s. Whether you’re returning for a family tradition or experiencing Harvest Days for the first time, there’s something to discover throughout the weekend.
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.title: Evening Compline — Wed Oct 14, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster

item.title: Lancaster Heart Walk — Sat Oct 17, 9:00 AM — Long’s Park
item.description:
In a heartbeat, you could be the difference.
9 out of 10 people who suffer cardiac arrest outside the hospital don’t survive. Most of the time, it’s because no one nearby performed CPR. But together, we can change that.
Extraordinary things happen when people take action. A small step. A simple skill. A lifesaving moment.
Heart Walk brings communities together to create health and hope for every heartbeat. Every walker who joins, every dollar donated, means more people trained in CPR, more research and more lifesaving moments for everyone.
Extraordinary starts with YOU. Join Heart Walk today.
Learn More
Source: Fig Lancaster

item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
